message:
Partial refunds now come out at the right amount. The bug was in `src/payments/partial-refund.js`: it multiplied the amount by `percent` (0–100) without dividing by 100. A 50% refund of 1250 therefore came out as 62500 instead of 625. I changed it to `Math.round(payment.amount * percent / 100)`.

`npm test` passes: all 20 tests, including the two in `test/payments-partial-refund.test.js`.
